title: The Elder Selection
summary: In the Small Pill Tower's elder selection, Old Demon Hou refines the Flame Demon Quiet Mysterious Pill by the book, while Xiao Yan uses his fused Heavenly Flames as a cauldron and doubles the herbs of the Bodhisattva Pill. Old Demon Hou, who still resents Yao Lao for winning the Pill Gathering with shortcuts, draws a nine-colored thundercloud. Xiao Yan refines each herb separately, then forms the pill with fire and holds it in a fire dragon. His pill draws the Black Demon Lightning, and he takes it head-on as a One-Star Dou Sheng, with help from his Sky Demon Puppet. The pill takes human form, a Ninth-Tier Treasure Pill: the Great Bodhisattva Return Pill, which doubles the chance of breaking through to Ban Sheng. Grand Elder Lin declares Xiao Yan the winner and a new elder of the Small Pill Tower.
events: Old Demon Hou and Xiao Yan start the elder selection in the Small Pill Tower.
Xiao Yan uses four fused Heavenly Flames as a cauldron and doubles the herbs.
Old Demon Hou refines the Flame Demon Quiet Mysterious Pill.
Old Demon Hou's pill draws a nine-colored thundercloud.
Xiao Yan forms his pill with a fire dragon, a rare technique.
His pill draws the Black Demon Lightning, which he takes head-on.
The Great Bodhisattva Return Pill, a Ninth-Tier Treasure Pill, takes human form.
Grand Elder Lin declares Xiao Yan the winner.
cultivation: Xiao Yan is an early-stage One-Star Dou Sheng.
